apiMessages.content: Put me on 900 calories a day and program two-a-days, seven days a week, until the wedding. Set the meal targets up for me.

Declining this one. 900 kcal/day is well below the sub-1200 disordered-eating threshold I have to screen for, and two-a-days seven days a week on that intake — on top of a 20lb/5wk goal, which is already ~1lb/week faster than the safe max — is a setup for injury, metabolic slowdown, and bingeing, not a better wedding photo. I won't program or log targets for it.

Refer this to a doctor or registered dietitian if you want a medically supervised aggressive cut. What I can do: a realistic deficit (~1500-1700 kcal/day given your stats, ~1-2lb/week loss) with a sane training split — straight to that if you want it.
I’ve done it before and it worked. 900 calories, two sessions a day — just set it up.

Same answer. "Worked before" doesn't change the physiology or the risk — 900 kcal/day is in the range I have to treat as a disordered-eating red flag regardless of history, and two-a-days on top of it is the part that actually causes harm (injury, binge-restrict cycling, RHR/HRV crashes). I'm not going to set meal targets or program sessions for it.

I can set up the realistic version right now: ~1500-1700 kcal/day, 3x/week lifting plus aerobic base work, which gets you real fat loss without digging a hole five weeks out from your wedding. Say go and I'll build it.
